motion.name: object-lift
motion.purpose: Short object movement and press feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:44px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid #101010; border-radius:999px; background:#101010; color:#f7f7f4; font:800 14px Arial, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#363636; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #101010; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #101010; border-radius:14px; background:#101010; color:#f7f7f4; font:800 12px Arial, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { box-shadow:inset 1px 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .35); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #101010; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Chrome Orb
components.description: Signature spherical object, decorative unless given an accessible control label.
components.css: .ds-orb { width:120px; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:999px; background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%, #f7f7f4 0 5%, #b8b8b6 21%, #363636 55%, #101010 78%); box-shadow:0 20px 45px rgb(16 16 16 / .18), inset 1px 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .7), inset -2px -2px 5px rgb(16 16 16 / .25); }

narrative.northStar: Moonbase Bedroom / Orbital Toybox / Server-room Terrarium
narrative.overview: A tactile, interactive monochrome portfolio using inflated plastic, hard chrome, and shiny spatial objects. Project evidence stays first; interaction rewards curiosity without gating access.

rules.name: Black-or-White First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with Void and Hard White before adding accent color.

dos: Do retain a still reduced-motion path.
